cases.name: Margarita Martinez Morehead
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Margarita loved helping and caring for others; both those closest to her as well as those she came across in her life’s path. She was conscientious and naturally she started her own cleaning company. Her clients adored and respected her. She became an extension of their families.

Margarita assisted her community by preparing food for the homeless and those less fortunate.

Margarita’s first priority was her family. She was the sole provider for her elderly 91-year-old mother who lives overseas in the Dominican Republic, along with numerous young nieces and nephews, funding their education and schooling. She always put others before herself, and her kindness and love knew no bounds. She cared for her four adult children and grandchildren with love and graceful dignity.

Margarita was born in La Romana, Dominican Republic in 1963. She moved to Cambridge Massachusetts in 1988 to pursue the American Dream and provide for her family. She naturally became a pillar of her community both here and abroad."
cases.narrative:
On 5/8/2023, she was found fatally stabbed on the floor of her apartment on LaFayette Avenue in Chelsea, MA. On the morning of her death, Alvarez was at Morehead's apartment and they were arguing over her attempt to leave him, prosecutors said.

"She threatened to call the police if he did not leave and she picked up a cellphone," Assistant District Attorney Erin Murphy said in court. "At that point, the defendant punched Ms. Morehead twice in the face and then became enraged when she said that her daughter, who was expected to visit later that morning, would see her injuries and that he would go to jail.

"The defendant grabbed a large kitchen knife at that point and stabbed Ms. Morehead multiple times in the chest and once in the back.
